title: TimeRoute: Time-Aware Modality Routing and Diffusion for Multi-Modal Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2608.10983v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multi-modal recommenders fuse user-item interaction signals with item modalities such as text, images, and audio, but the usefulness of each drifts over time and at different rates. For example, around Valentine's Day, chocolate purchases become less driven by textual ingredient cues and more by visual packaging and ambient audio. This \emph{modality time-scale mismatch} gives rise to two coupled challenges: (1) users with different temporal behavior profiles require different modality proportions, and (2) less relevant modalities are more likely to introduce outdated or misleading signals into the recommender. We address both challenges within a unified diffusion-based recommender, \textbf{TimeRoute}. A temporal-aware modal router maps each user's aggregated temporal profile to a personalized modality distribution, replacing the globally shared fusion weights used in prior work. translated_title: TimeRoute：面向多模态推荐的时间感知模态路由与扩散
translated_abstract: 多模态推荐系统将用户-物品交互信号与物品模态（如文本、图像和音频）相融合，但每种模态的效用会随时间以不同速率漂移。例如，在情人节前后，巧克力购买行为受文本成分提示的影响减弱，而更多受视觉包装和环境音频驱动。这种“模态时间尺度不匹配”引发了两个相互关联的挑战：（1）具有不同时间行为特征的用户需要不同的模态比例；（2）相关性较低的模态更可能向推荐系统引入过时或误导性信号。我们在一个统一的基于扩散的推荐系统TimeRoute中同时解决这两个挑战。一个时间感知的模态路由器将每个用户的聚合时间特征映射到个性化的模态分布，取代了先前工作中使用的全局共享融合权重。基于扩散的图重构器被条件化...
tldr: 本文提出TimeRoute，通过时间感知模态路由和扩散重构器，解决多模态推荐中模态效用随时间漂移的问题，实现个性化模态分配和去噪。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TimeRoute, which addresses modality utility drift over time in multi-modal recommendation via temporal-aware modality routing and diffusion-based graph reconstruction, enabling personalized modality allocation and denoising.
